Help


The syslog function, if enabled, sends firewall log messages to the specified Server IP Address using the specified Server Port. You must have a UNIX-compatible syslog client for this feature.

Server IP Address: The Server IP can be specified in IPv4 (nnn.nnn.nnn.nnn) format or IPv6 format or FQDN format.

Server Port: The Server Port must be 1-65535.

Log Level: This level is the severity level of firewall log sent to the syslog client. The severity level of the system may be more inclusive than that of the syslog. The levels in decreasing order of severity are:
  1. L0 - Emergency
  2. L1 - Alert
  3. L2 - Critical
  4. L3 - Error
  5. L4 - Warning
  6. L5 - Notice
